data.name: Janvi
data.gender_notes: Janvi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Janvi is derived from the Sanskrit language, where 'Jan' means wisdom and 'vi' means knowledge. This name is associated with the Hindu goddess Saraswati, who is the embodiment of knowledge, learning, and wisdom. The name Janvi signifies a girl who is wise, intelligent, and knowledgeable. The name Janvi carries the meaning “Goddess of wisdom and knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Janvi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wisdom and knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom
data.etymology: Janvi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of wisdom and knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Janvi total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
